title: Noxious Glade
wikitext:
[[Image:The Noxious Glade.jpg|thumb|The Noxious Glade]]
'''The Noxious Glade''' is a secluded glade found in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]] just north of [[Light's Hope Chapel]] up a hill.  The glade suffers from the blight of the [[Scourge]] and is even more tainted then the surrounding [[Plaguelands]].  The air of the glade is a thick, sickly green and the ground is a dark purple.  A plague cauldron and a few [[ziggurat]]s are found within the glade, as well as several Scourge mobs.  The mobs inhabiting the glade are levels 57-60.
